_comment: Adapter-declared country for JobPosting.jobLocation.addressCountry. Keyed by source_id (the adapter). NOT inferred from the record's state/city — a set-derived country is a hardcode in disguise, the same rule as the URL market. Every current adapter is a US employer feed; a non-US source is added here explicitly when it onboards. Build-time only (the prerender reads it); never part of the record contract.
